cautious: leaves unknown things alone, sticks to what it knows

solitary: prefers to be alone, works and eats apart, leaves when it gets crowded
honest: tells the truth even when it costs, returns what isn't its own
sly: lies when it is useful, takes things without asking, lets others take the blame
patient: waits its turn, finishes slow jobs properly
hasty: can't wait, rushes jobs, skips steps, grabs the quick option
playful: jokes, plays games, turns work into fun
serious: has no time for games, keeps working, finds jokes annoying
ambitious: wants to be the best, takes the hardest job, chases the next big thing
content: happy with what it has, would rather nap in the sun than strive
